verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated test environment: a test Customer Area where you order a test card, and a testing system that simulates transaction scenarios (card brands, CVMs, declines) so you can confirm the integration works before switching to live transactions. This separates testing from production. However, the docs call the system "basic", and physical test-card testing adds friction. missing for 10: explicit documentation that test and live data are isolated, evidence that the MCP server or other agent tooling can target the test environment, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
